normal_grading_architecture.chatgpt_role: new-evidence interpretation and source-level structured judgments only
normal_grading_architecture.local_python_role: longitudinal state, status/grades, intervention routing, HTML reports, PowerSchool exports, archives, email PDF preparation
normal_grading_architecture.state_guard: Local apply requires exact parent state SHA-256 + state_version + state_id match before any state/report installation.
normal_grading_architecture.course_control_panel_rule: Normal course panels do not ask the teacher to select current state. They use the localhost companion for state-aware grading-request creation, local roster maintenance, report viewing, and email preparation.
normal_grading_architecture.roster_update: PowerSchool roster/template CSV file(s) + optional note are applied locally. Missing students become inactive; added students receive current Unit No Evidence / Not assessed rows; current reports/PowerSchool exports refresh.
normal_grading_architecture.first_state_rule: If no state exists and the selected course Unit has a registered learning map, local roster maintenance may initialize state_version 1 without exposing a normal first/reset control.
normal_grading_architecture.teacher_observations: Direct teacher observations are applied locally as longitudinal evidence; paper walk-around checklists may be uploaded as a small grading request and return the normal Portfolio_Grading_Result.json.
normal_grading_architecture.observation_independence: One classroom observation session counts as one opportunity per student/I Can; repeated marks from the same moment/session do not create extra independent opportunities.
normal_grading_architecture.report_hub: View Reports exposes Student Reports, Teacher Report, and PowerSchool Exports for the selected local course/Unit.

state_zip.integrity: Every files[] entry records path + sha256. Local grading-result application increments state_version by exactly one and records parent_state_sha256 as the exact previously installed current-state ZIP hash.
state_zip.raw_evidence: Historical raw evidence bytes are not carried in every state ZIP; durable source hashes/names/labels/mapping/judgments remain in the evidence ledger.

results_zip.installer_rule: Installer first asks Updated state only / Results only / State + results, then shows only the needed chooser(s). Any installed results package also refreshes local folders 03-05 from student_reports/, teacher_report/, and powerschool/.
results_zip.local_runtime_rule: Normal new-evidence runs are built locally from Portfolio_Grading_Result.json and install state/results transactionally after validator/identity QA passes.
results_zip.report_refresh_only: Legacy/maintenance report-only requests may still install Portfolio_Results.zip without changing state.

email.normal_pdf_generation: Local only, on demand, from the current individual HTML reports using installed Chrome/Edge/Chromium.
email.identity_gate: student ID in state + visible student identity in HTML must match; recipient matching uses durable student ID.
email.send_rule: Prepare Portfolio Emails.command creates PDFs and a delivery manifest only. It does not send email.
email.selection_rule: Email preparation is student-selectable. Active roster checkboxes default selected; Select All/Deselect All are provided; PDFs/manifests are generated only for currently selected students.

migration.normal_runs_after_migration: Drive reads/writes are forbidden unless explicitly requested for backup/recovery.

control_panel_actions: build observation grading request from completed checklist
local_companion.privacy: Never serves outside localhost; report file serving is restricted to the selected local Portfolio Unit directory.
local_companion.launcher_behavior: Start Portfolio Local Companion.command installs/refreshes a per-user macOS LaunchAgent, starts the localhost service, and opens its page. The service restarts automatically on login; no Terminal window must remain open.
